         ANILINUM

       Coal Tar Product-Amidobenzene


Marked giddiness and pain in head;   face has a
      purple hue  . Pain in penis and scrotum with swelling.   Tumors
      of the urinary passages  . Profound anæmia with discoloration of skin, blue lips,
      anorexia, gastric disturbances. Swelling of skin.



Relationship.--  Compare:   Arsenic;
      Antipyrin  .
